description: This file defines extension methods for configuring streaming support in Orleans client builders, including adding support for streaming, in-memory streams with default or custom serializers, and persistent streams with custom adapter factories.

classes.name: ClientBuilderStreamingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure streaming support on Orleans IClientBuilder instances.

methods.name: AddStreaming
methods.description: Adds support for streaming to the Orleans client by configuring services.

methods.name: AddMemoryStreams
methods.description: Adds an in-memory stream provider with default serializer to the Orleans client.

methods.name: AddMemoryStreams<TSerializer>
methods.description: Adds an in-memory stream provider with a specified serializer to the Orleans client.

methods.name: AddPersistentStreams
methods.description: Adds a persistent streams provider with a custom adapter factory to the Orleans client.
